summary: The world-class pipeline UC was marked complete but 3 of 5 mission metrics it targets remain critically off target. The most urgent issue is a QC dispatch failure leaving 15 PRs permanently stuck in awaiting_merge with no reviewer. Auto-Recovery Rate remains at 0% (target 95%). Rework rate is 52.4% (target 3%) by world_class_distance measurement. The UC itself was prematurely closed — 8 of 10 planned WCP tasks were cancelled rather than completed.

findings.summary: QC agent never dispatched for 15 awaiting_merge tasks — merge queue fully blocked
findings.details: All 15 tasks in awaiting_merge have code_reviews.status = pending and reviewer_agent = NULL. Oldest from June 10 (5 days). Only 6/45 PRs merged in last 7 days (13.3% rate). checkPRReviews() is not spawning QC agents.

findings.summary: Auto-Recovery Rate: 0% vs target 95% — self-healing is non-functional
findings.details: Bug auto-fix miss rate 63.2% (12/19 bug-class tasks not auto-fixed). Rescue tasks for the related UC are PARKED stale. Genome detects failures but cannot recover autonomously.

findings.summary: Dev Task Rework Rate: 52.4% by world_class_distance (target 3%), 41.2% by mission_metrics (target 10%)
findings.details: 22/42 completed tasks were rework. 83/134 child tasks were quality-miss rework (62%). QC First-Pass Rate 71% vs target 90%.

findings.summary: Cost tracking totalCost7d is a garbled concatenated string — cost dashboard untrustworthy
findings.details: Genome self-assessment shows totalCost7d as '012.270.43...' — string concatenation bug in cost aggregator.

findings.summary: uc-genome-world-class-pipeline marked complete but 8/10 tasks were cancelled
findings.details: Only WCP-4 and WCP-8 P1a completed. WCP-5, WCP-7, WCP-8 P0a/P0b/P1b/P2, and WCP-9 all cancelled. UC prematurely closed.
